architecture.title: The system and its authority boundary
architecture.caption: Vercel serves the browser files. Convex owns the records and decisions. The backend schedules external work; model output cannot grant permission.

data_model.title: Records connected by identity
data_model.caption: Lines show logical connections between stored records, not a complete database schema or cardinality diagram. IDs let the app trace a decision back to its company, source, bill and authority.

graph.title: The Brightline relationship graph
graph.caption: A relationship determines relevant scope. Scores prioritize review; they are not probabilities. Reporter exclusion from sister exposures does not itself exempt the reporter’s payments.

intake.title: From a report to permitted consequences
intake.caption: Observation is the default low-authority path. A confirm-capable source must satisfy its requirements; a human reviewer must provide independent evidence before promotion.

clocks.title: Different clocks serve different purposes
clocks.caption: The diagram is conceptual, not a time-scale chart. Existing held payments never auto-release because a review deadline or incident window expires.

payment_states.title: Payment states and cash effects
payment_states.caption: The result depends on current rules. A hold or rejection creates no payment journal. A later release pays the held attempt atomically with its evidence.

recovery.title: Correction preserves the original history
recovery.caption: A controller and AP requester must be distinct. The same controller may prepare and later release. The prior verified destination needs a fresh human callback assertion.

purchase_authority.title: Approval comes before autonomous purchasing
purchase_authority.caption: Permission is a stored, revocable, bounded record. A preview reserves nothing. Execution rechecks everything inside the transaction.

purchase_sequence.title: A successful console run in order
purchase_sequence.caption: This is the private Convex console path. The external assistant’s MCP HTTP route is separate. Provider calls occur outside the financial transaction.

holds.title: Where the initial held money is
holds.caption: Bayview combines $28,000 and $12,000. Later requests, imports and releases change these totals. Bar lengths start at zero.

visa.title: Visa judging weights
visa.caption: Source: supplied Visa starter pack, pages 6–7. These are rubric weights, not estimated Sidecall scores. Bar lengths start at zero.
